sections.text: The permanent product may not yet be chosen, but the current opening can still be evaluated for temporary protection. sections.text: Providers preparing a proposal may need to inspect different parts of the assembly. sections.text: We will describe the work completed and any area left unresolved because of access or surrounding condition. sections.text: An opening above may improve access to one section while other areas remain reachable only from below. We will identify the routes available and the material included in the proposed work. The floor-repair boundary will not automatically define the full release area.

sections.text: Debris or components proposed for disposal may sit beside material that requires cleaning, drying or further evaluation.
